_comment: Import-dodge transform control. FIRST_PARTY is rewritten to an equal tuple by a different expression while the band member only loads the tool and compares the constant, so it MUST ESCAPE. This spec DECLARES itself a control by its suffix: bd-mutate reports CONTROL-ESCAPED (expected) and exits 0; CONTROL-CAUGHT, exit 1, would mean the loader sees the rewrite.
subject: an equal-value rewrite of FIRST_PARTY escapes a band member that only loads the tool

mutants.label: FIRST_PARTY rebuilt as () + the same tuple, judged by a load-only node
